question: What condition is said to hold for even the wise person when burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of juice?
premises: A location is indicated at the tip of nectar.
An instrument is indicated by the tip of juice.
Even the wise person, while burning, is in question under that condition.
inference: Even the wise person, while burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of juice, remains in the condition stated.
uncertainties: The outcome for the wise person in this condition is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of juice, even the wise person, while burning, also.
